test_get_interaction_pairs: test the SeamlessInteractionFS.get_interaction_pairs method to discover and download interaction pairs from the dataset
test_get_session_groups: test the SeamlessInteractionFS.get_session_groups method to sample and organize session groups from the dataset
test_download_batch_from_s3: test the SeamlessInteractionFS.download_batch_from_s3 method to download a batch of file IDs from S3
test_download_batch_from_hf: test the SeamlessInteractionFS.download_batch_from_hf method to download batch archives from HuggingFace with parallel processing
test_get_interaction_metadata: test the SeamlessInteractionFS.get_interaction_metadata method to extract and validate interaction metadata including participants and file IDs
